conversation.name: Halden Mutual — memo setup call
messages: Ines Varga (procurement lead, Halden Mutual): For every purchase memo, put the total cost of ownership over three years in the first paragraph. Our committee reads nothing else.
Quill (Quillstack's memo assistant): Understood. Three-year total cost of ownership goes in the first paragraph of every Halden memo.
Ines Varga (procurement lead, Halden Mutual): Vendors must be on our approved-supplier list, and any memo above 25,000 euros goes to Marek Holm in treasury for approval.
Quill (Quillstack's memo assistant): Noted: approved-supplier list only, and memos above 25,000 euros are routed to Marek Holm in treasury.
Ines Varga (procurement lead, Halden Mutual): Write the memos in British English, and never name a competitor bank in a memo.

pinned.text: Halden Mutual: memo drafts are kept in memory for 90 days, then deleted (master agreement section 7.2).
pinned.amended: Halden Mutual: memo drafts are kept in memory for 60 days, then deleted (master agreement section 7.2, amendment 1 signed 2026-10-09).

pinned.text: Halden Mutual security contact for incidents: the vendor-risk team at Halden Mutual, reply within 24 hours.

support_note: Support note: Halden Mutual asked that Quillstack staff sign in to the admin console with SSO only.

questions.text: Does each integration get its own credential, and is the secret shown only once and never retrievable afterwards?
Can a credential be rotated so that the old secret stops working at once, without losing or re-ingesting data?
Can a credential be limited to one customer's data (one tenant) and denied administrative actions?
When an integration is retired, can its access be cut off immediately — and what happens to the data it wrote?
Can temporary credentials (contractors, one-off jobs) expire automatically at a set time?
Is every change to our memory recorded with what changed, when, and from what source — and which credential made it?
If we leave, can all of our memory be deleted, and can you show it is gone?
